risks.title: Geopolitical tensions and trade wars
risks.summary: Trade tensions, particularly with China and other Asian countries, threaten Apple's supply chain and could lead to cost increases or shortages.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is positioned at the beginning of the Macroeconomic and Industry Risks section, with strong language on uncertainty, potential escalation, and direct impact on supply chain and tariffs. The text mentions measures announced as early as Q2 2025 and sector-specific investigations (e.g., semiconductors), reinforcing its timeliness and severity. The Geopolitical category carries high weight given Asian supply concentration. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on Asian supply chain
risks.summary: Apple relies heavily on external manufacturers in Asia, exposing the company to supply disruptions in case of local crises or conflicts.
risks.score_rationale: The document emphasizes that the majority of manufacturing occurs in Asia (China, Vietnam, Taiwan, etc.) through outsourced partners. Geographic concentration is explicitly linked to major risks in case of disruption. The language stresses difficulty of rapid substitution, and the risk is exacerbated by single sources. Central position in the 10-K, with high intensity. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Aggressive competition in technology markets
risks.summary: Apple faces intense competition from tech giants capable of selling at a loss, threatening its margins and market position.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is described as structural, with margin pressure, product imitation, and low pricing. Apple acknowledges a minority market share in several key segments. The language is repetitive and emphasizes constant threat, although the risk is stable compared to the prior year. The Competition category carries medium to high weight. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Disruptions from global economic conditions
risks.summary: Deterioration in global economic conditions may reduce demand for Apple's premium products, affecting sales and profitability.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is extensively developed, mentioning recession, inflation, interest rates, and consumer confidence. It is directly tied to demand for Apple products, often considered premium. The text cites impacts on customers, suppliers, and liquidity. Strong language and early positioning in the document. High Macro weighting. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Cyberattacks and digital security risks
risks.summary: Apple is exposed to cyberattacks, including ransomware, which could disrupt its services and damage its reputation.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is mentioned in the context of business interruptions (e.g., ransomware). While less developed than others, it is associated with direct threats to services and infrastructure. The language is preventive but serious. The Cybersecurity category is critical for a technology company. Secondary but implicit across multiple threats. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Dependence on single or limited suppliers
risks.summary: Apple uses numerous components from single suppliers, increasing the risk of disruption if a partner faces issues.
risks.score_rationale: The text explicitly mentions reliance on single sources for critical components. A single supplier disruption could lead to major consequences, amplified by supply chain complexity. Strong language on potential impact ('exacerbate any negative consequences'). Existential risk in case of major failure. Industrial category highly weighted here. (default score, to be refined)

risks.title: Innovation and accelerated renewal cycles
risks.summary: Apple must continuously innovate to maintain competitiveness, but launch failures or delays could harm results and reputation.
risks.score_rationale: The risk is central in the Business Risks section, with strong emphasis on the need for constant innovation. Launch or transition failure could significantly impact revenue. The text mentions technical, production, and market acceptance challenges. Although recurring, the intensity of language and competitive pressure justify high severity. (default score, to be refined)
